nom: Palmer's Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator with Chamomile (3.17 Oz)

avis.texte: Palmer's Coconut Oil Formula Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator is a gentle yet effective skincare product designed for those looking to refresh and nourish their skin. Ideal for anyone wanting a natural exfoliation experience, this scrub combines the moisturizing benefits of coconut oil with the exfoliating power of coconut sugar. The scrub's texture is pleasantly grainy but smooth enough to avoid irritation, making it suitable for sensitive skin types. As you massage it onto your face, the coconut sugar gently buffs away dead skin cells, revealing a brighter, smoother complexion. Meanwhile, the coconut oil deeply hydrates, leaving skin feeling soft and supple rather than dry or tight. One of the standout features is its delightful, natural coconut scent, which makes skincare feel like a small indulgence. After using the scrub, my skin looked noticeably more radiant and felt refreshed without any redness or discomfort. It's a perfect addition to a weekly skincare routine to maintain healthy, glowing skin. Overall, Palmer's Coconut Oil Formula Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub Exfoliator strikes a lovely balance between gentle exfoliation and rich moisturization. It’s an excellent choice for those seeking a natural, effective way to brighten their skin while enjoying the nourishing qualities of coconut oil. I would recommend it to anyone wanting a simple, pleasant exfoliator that delivers visible results without harshness.

Smells Amazing and Leaves Skin Soft I really like this Palmer’s Coconut Oil Formula scrub. It has a sweet coconut scent that isn’t too strong, and it leaves my skin feeling smooth and moisturized after using it. The scrub texture works well for exfoliating without being too harsh. I gave it 4 stars because the tube is a little smaller than expected, but overall it’s a great product and works well for soft, glowing skin.

avis.titre: Left my face feeling soft and smooth, smells amazing!
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing! I’ve been wanting to get a face scrub for some time now, and I almost bought an expensive high-end brand one just because I wanted to make sure it worked well. I decided to give the Palmer’s one a try first and I’m so glad I did. It wasn’t overly abrasive but had enough grit to polish my face nicely. It left my face feeling so soft and smooth, my pores clean and it smells absolutely amazing. A new must-have for me! Definitely give it a try if you’re looking for a face scrub.

This is actually a very nice product. It has kind of a spa like sent to it and is a good exfoliator. I use a lot of high-end exfoliators and I got this just to try something different. I'll still be using the others but I like this as a change and the scent is nice as well as moisturizing after the exfoliation.

smells like a coconut, and definitely is a good scrub. warms up skin shortly after scrubbing, so i guess, it's working! has a twist top, which was a surprise to me. the result is great - clean and polished skin is just what i need.

avis.titre: gently exfoliates away dirt and dead skin cells
avis.texte: A face scrub that gently exfoliates away dirt and dead skin cells to reveal softer, calmer skin with a smooth, radiant glow..it works..and there is value for my money...quick shipping....I love the scrub

avis.titre: 💖 Soft, radiant, and perfectly smooth skin in just a few minutes!
avis.texte: An excellent scrub! It gently exfoliates the skin, leaving it immediately softer, smoother, and more radiant. The coconut scent is delicious, and the texture is pleasant to use. My skin looks fresh and well-cared-for after every use. 🥥✨
Sensitive skin becomes dry in New England weather! This scrub smells wonderful and works great on removing dry skin!

avis.titre: A scrub that makes me feel like a coconut god.
avis.texte: I tried the Palmer's Coconut Sugar Facial Scrub and now I’m pretty sure my face has been transported to a tropical beach where I’m lounging under a palm tree with a coconut drink in hand. The smell? Heavenly. It’s like someone captured the essence of a tropical vacation and put it in a bottle, so now I can exfoliate and pretend I’m on a beach, even if I’m just sitting in my bathroom. The sugar scrub itself? Magical. It’s like a gentle but effective spa treatment for your face — it exfoliates without turning your skin into a red, irritated mess. I feel like I’m getting the royal treatment every time I use it, and my skin is left feeling so soft and smooth, I’m convinced I’ve unlocked the secret to baby-soft skin. Seriously, if I could bottle the feeling of after-scrub skin, I’d sell it and make millions. And let's talk about the coconut oil — it leaves my skin hydrated but not greasy. It’s like my skin just had the perfect drink of water, without looking like I’m ready for a slip-n-slide. Every time I use it, I get to experience luxury in a jar, all while pretending I’m living in a beachside bungalow. So if you want your face to feel as fresh and fabulous as a vacation, this scrub is your new best friend. You’ll feel like you’ve just walked out of a spa with glowing, radiant skin — minus the hefty price tag

I am sold on this product. At first I thought this was quite grainy feeling, a bit much. However, I got used to it and this helped my skin and makes shaving so much easier and smoother. I have found my face scrub, finally!
Sanft, riecht gut, perfekte tube: kappe drehbar: ein klecks creme erscheint!. Zudrehen, hinstellen . Keine lose kappe, wunderbar bei nassen händen!

avis.titre: Great for smoothing out the skin.
avis.texte: Lovely feel nice to use certainly makes skin feel polished closest to a micro cleanser that I used to use.

avis.titre: Leaves My Skin Feeling So Soft
avis.texte: I’ve been really happy with this facial scrub. It exfoliates well without feeling too harsh on my skin, and my face always feels smoother and softer after using it. I also love the coconut scent it makes my skincare routine feel a little more enjoyable. A little goes a long way, and I’ve already added it to my regular routine.
This scrub leaves my face feeling very smooth and fresh ,I also used the palmers moisturizer after which have a very coconut smell ,I’m not mad at it at all.

I've tried many face scrubs, and the one that I had used the most is St. Ive's Apricot Face Scrub. I didn't like how I felt it tore off my face, but I figured it was normal for any type of scrub. Enter Palmer's Coconut Scrub - I was influenced into buying this by @thesisterstudioig and was a little skeptical about it working for me. I know the importance of exfoliating, especially in the dry winter climate where I live, so I wanted to give it a shot. After trying it, I fell in love and it is now part of my weekly skin regimen. Now, I'm on my second tube of the scrub and have it on subscribe and save so I don't run out. Here are the three things that I like most about this coconut scrub: 1. Gentle on my skin, yet effective. Unlike the St. Ive's Apricot Scrub, I don't feel like this is ripping my skin to pieces. Although it is gentle, I notice the my skin is smoother and softer after I use it (I use it every other day). 2. Natural I love that it is natural and doesn't have any of the bad stuff. I try to be more aware of what I put on my skin, but I'm not always conscious of what is in the beauty products I use. I love that I can feel comfortable using this every other day. 3. Affordable and Last a Long Time The last thing I love about this product is that it isn't expensive and a little goes a long way! I love this scrub! I was looking for a facial scrub that left my skin looking glowy & hydrated! This one did the trick Smells great and I love the twist top. I would highly recommend!

I cannot believe it but I got six tubes!! I thought it was just a one pack but I got six tubes so very happy about the purchase. The smell is nice and the price you cannot beat good product.
I love love this product for my face. Leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean. Not harsh at all. Light and smells good..

avis.titre: Revised review.  I was finally able to remove the cap from the tube.
avis.texte: This is the best face scrub. The sugar granules dissolve in water, so they don't clog your drains. The coconut smell is wonderful. Your skin feels smooth and soft. The newest tube I had purchased was extremely difficult to open. I thought the only option was to squeeze the lotion through the cap. Fortunately, my husband was able to unscrew the cap for me, so I don't need to get the product out from the hole in the cap. I don't know why they have the hole in the cap. It is much better to get the lotion out by unscrewing the cap from the tube.

This is a good, budget exfoliator. The sugar granules do not dissolve too fast so you’ll have plenty of time to scrub. I think it’s fine for sensitive skin but I have experienced slight burning when I had open acne but nothing significant. It hasn’t broke me out and in my opinion has helped heal my acne. It’s moisturizing in the sense that it doesn’t dry your skin out but it doesn’t leave a thick moisture film either, which is good for me. I recommend cleansing before using as this is an exfoliator and not a cleanser. I also recommend rinsing completely as granules can stick to your face after use. This comes unsealed. It is a legitimate product as I compared it to the one I purchased at Walgreens and everything is the same. This is truly one of the best drugstore exfoliators on the market right now for most skin types. When used properly it gives excellent results.

This product is honestly really great. I thought my skin looked smoother almost immediately. I’m 43 and have the fine lines and larger pores, and was dealing with a lot of clogged pores. I hated using the magnifying mirror to do my brows because of it. A week in, my fiancée starts asking me if I’d gotten Botox again “or something”. I asked why and he said your skin just looks so smooth and bright. He keeps saying it, thinking I’ve underhanded him and thrown down 500 a few months early. He’s so impressed he’s started using it and I am not lying when I say that is super I Saul for his construction guy self. Lol

avis.titre: Wish I could give it more than five stars! It’s my favorite exfoliator!
avis.texte: This facial scrub is my favorite exfoliator. It’s the perfect balance of being gentle but also gritty enough to really clean and exfoliate my skin. It’s super affordable and one of my favorite skincare products. I also use the Palmers face and body oils (mixed with my daily moisturizers) and love them as well. I took a photo of the product next to a standard tube of toothpaste just to provide a better representation of the product size. I also took a video showing the product in case you want a more thorough look. Hope that helps!

Check pics. Both have the exact same formula and ingredients
Palmers face scrub is definitely a 10/10 definitely recommend 🥥
